DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 安全教室の実演で、ご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions about the demonstration in the safety class?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の自転車では、ハンドルを握るとベルのレバーに右の親指が届きません。位置を変えた見本を見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 握った時にベルへ親指が届かず移設見本を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: On my bicycle, my right thumb cannot reach the bell lever when I hold the handlebar. Could you show me an example with its position changed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your thumb cannot reach the bell while gripping the handlebar, and ask to see an example with it repositioned.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この実演用のハンドルで、ベルを内側へ寄せてみます。握ったまま指が届くかお試しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will move the bell inward on this demonstration handlebar. Please try whether your finger can reach it while you keep your grip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今度は届きます。ただ、ブレーキのレバーと近いので、両方を一緒に触ってしまわないか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 内寄せで届くと確認しブレーキとの近さを確かめたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can reach it now. However, it is close to the brake lever, so I would like to check that I will not touch both at once.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that moving it inward makes it reachable, and say you want to check how close it is to the brake.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 止まった実演台で、それぞれのレバーを指してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please point to each lever on the stationary demonstration stand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらがブレーキ、こちらがベルですね。別々に触れられました。自分の自転車も、この位置にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二レバーを別々に触り実車も同位置にしたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: This is the brake and this is the bell, right? I was able to touch them separately. I would like this position on my bicycle too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you touched the two levers separately and want the same position on your own bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 実車への取り付けは、自転車店でご相談ください。この見本の位置は写真に残せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please consult a bicycle shop about installing it on your bicycle. You may take a photo of this example's position.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真を撮ります。ハンドル全体も入れて、店の方にどちら側へ寄せたいか示せるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見本全体を撮影し店で位置希望を示すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take a photo. I will include the whole handlebar so I can show the shop staff which side I want it moved toward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will photograph the whole example and show the shop your preferred position.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談の際に、届きにくい今の位置も説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you consult them, please also explain the current position that is hard to reach.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今のベルの写真と、この見本の写真を見せます。取り付け後は店で握り方とブレーキへの手の届き方も確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在と見本の写真で店に相談し取付後の届き方確認を望む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will show them a photo of my current bell and one of this example. After installation, I would also like to check my grip and how my hands reach the brakes at the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will consult the shop using photos of the current position and the example, and want to check reach after installation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご相談に写真をお役立てください。教室へのご参加ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use the photos when you consult them. Thank you for attending the class. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の中身を、こちらの用紙へお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please write the contents of your parcel on this form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 品物の名前と数は箱のふたの内側に貼ったメモにあります。まだ預けていないこの箱を、ここで開けて写してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未引渡し箱を開け内ふたの内容メモを窓口用紙へ写す許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The item names and quantities are on a note attached inside the box lid. May I open this box, which I have not handed over yet, here and copy them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for permission to open the box you have not handed over and copy the contents note inside its lid onto the counter form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの作業台でどうぞ。箱を置く場所を空けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please use this worktable. I will clear a space for the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ふたを開けました。ノート三冊と鉛筆十二本です。メモは受取人にも残したいので、はがさずに写します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ノート三冊鉛筆十二本を示し受取人用メモを残すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I have opened the lid. There are three notebooks and twelve pencils. I want to leave the note for the recipient too, so I will copy it without peeling it off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State in Japanese that there are three notebooks and twelve pencils and that you will leave the note for the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その二種類を、別々の行へご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please enter those two types on separate lines.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一行目にノート三冊、二行目に鉛筆十二本と書きました。鉛筆は六本入りを二組なので、合計十二本です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二行へ数量を書き鉛筆六本二組の合計を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I wrote three notebooks on the first line and twelve pencils on the second. The pencils are two packs of six, making twelve in total.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you wrote the quantities on two lines and that two packs of six pencils total twelve.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 箱に戻す物が、すべて入っているかお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check that everything that needs to go back into the box is inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: メモを見るために上の緩衝材だけ外しました。品物は出していません。緩衝材を同じ場所へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外した緩衝材だけ戻し品物未取出しと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I only removed the top packing material to see the note. I did not take the items out. I will put the packing material back in the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are putting back only the packing material you removed and did not take out the items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 用紙の数を確認してから、箱を閉じてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the quantities on the form before closing the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三冊と十二本で合っています。メモはふたの内側に残し、箱を閉じました。この用紙と一緒に荷物をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 数量と内側メモを確認して閉箱し用紙と共に渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Three notebooks and twelve pencils is correct. I left the note inside the lid and closed the box. Please take the parcel together with this form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the quantities and the note inside, close the box, and hand it over with the form in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、用紙とお荷物を確認いたします。ご準備ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will now check the form and your parcel. Thank you for preparing them. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日の相談内容を、画面の確認書でご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please review the record of today's consultation on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 文字が小さくて読みづらいです。署名する前に全文を読みたいので、大きく表示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 確認書を署名前に全文読めるよう文字拡大を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The text is small and hard to read. I want to read the whole document before signing. Could you enlarge it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to enlarge the text so you can read the entire confirmation document before signing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで表示を大きくします。縦に動かすと、下の段落も読めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will enlarge the display. Scrolling vertically lets you read the paragraphs below too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この大きさなら読めます。一番下まで読みたいので、画面を少しずつ動かしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 読める大きさで末尾まで少しずつスクロールを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can read it at this size. I want to read all the way to the bottom, so please scroll the screen a little at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to scroll slowly to the end at a readable size.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後の段落はこちらです。お読みになった内容について、ご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is the final paragraph. Do you have any questions about what you have read?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相談した内容と合っています。名前を書く場所が画面の外になったので、署名欄だけを次に見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相談内容一致を確認し署名欄表示を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It matches what we discussed. The place to write my name has moved off the screen, so please show me just the signature field next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that it matches the consultation and request the signature field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 署名欄へ移しました。こちらの枠へ、専用のペンでお名前をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have moved to the signature field. Please write your name in this box using the special pen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この枠ですね。手を画面に置くと文字が動きそうなので、ペンを使う間は端を支えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 専用ペン署名中の画面端支持を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: This box, right? The text might move if I rest my hand on the screen, so could you hold the edge steady while I use the pen?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the screen's edge to be held steady while you sign with the special pen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 端を支えます。書き終えたお名前も、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will hold the edge. Please also check the name you have written.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書けました。自分の名前が読めます。全文を読んでから署名できました。確認書の控えを受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己署名を確認し確認書控えを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have finished writing. I can read my name. I was able to sign after reading the whole document. I would like a copy of the confirmation document.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check your signature and request a copy of the confirmation document in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当から控えをご案内します。本日のご相談ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The person in charge will explain how to get a copy. Thank you for your consultation today. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: じょうごをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a funnel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家の洗剤容器は口が狭くて、詰め替えの袋からこぼしてしまいます。口に入る細いじょうごはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 狭い洗剤容器でこぼれるため細いじょうごを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The opening of my detergent container at home is narrow, and I spill detergent from the refill pouch. Do you have a thin funnel that fits the opening?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a thin funnel because detergent spills when refilling a narrow-opening container.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの細い方は、先の外径が八ミリです。容器の口は測ってありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This thinner one's tip has an outside diameter of eight millimeters. Have you measured the container opening?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 内側が十二ミリでした。八ミリなら入る余地がありますね。上の口は袋を当てられる広さでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 内径十二ミリを示し上口の幅を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The inside diameter was twelve millimeters. Eight millimeters would leave room for it to fit. Is the top opening wide enough to rest the pouch against?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the twelve-millimeter inside diameter and ask about the width of the top opening in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 上の口の直径は六センチです。一本二百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The top opening is six centimeters across. One costs two hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 六センチ、二百円ですね。食品用とは別にして、洗剤の詰め替えだけに使いたいです。持ち手はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 六センチ二百円を確認し洗剤専用の持ち手を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Six centimeters and two hundred yen, right? I want to keep it separate from food-use funnels and use it only for refilling detergent. Does it have a handle?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm six centimeters and two hundred yen, and ask in Japanese about a handle for detergent-only use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらに小さな持ち手があります。手に取って形をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a small handle here. Please pick it up and look at its shape.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持ち手をつまめました。容器を平らな所に置けば、片手でじょうごを支え、もう片方で袋を傾けられます。この形にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持ち手を試し平らな場所の容器へ片手じょうご片手袋で注ぐ形を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can pinch the handle. If I put the container on a flat surface, I can support the funnel with one hand and tilt the pouch with the other. I will choose this shape.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Try the handle and say in Japanese that you choose this shape to pour into a container on a flat surface, holding the funnel in one hand and the pouch in the other.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同じ形で二本入りもありますが、どちらになさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We also have a pack of two in the same shape. Which would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一本だけお願いします。家の容器は一つなので、これで会計します。口の寸法を測ってきてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容器一つ用の一本購入を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Just one, please. I have one container at home, so I will pay for this. I am glad I measured the opening before coming.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to buy one funnel for your one container.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、一本でお会計いたします。ご利用ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will ring up one funnel. Thank you for shopping with us. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 木を描いていらっしゃいますね。場所のことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are drawing a tree, I see. Are you having trouble with where you are sitting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あの木を描いていますが、このベンチでは紙が揺れます。木が見えて、風を受けにくい場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 木の描画を続けるため見通しを保つ防風場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am drawing that tree, but the paper flutters on this bench. Is there somewhere sheltered from the wind where I can still see the tree?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a sheltered place with a clear view so you can continue drawing the tree.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 低い壁の内側に別のベンチがあります。木は横から見える位置です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is another bench inside the low wall. It gives a view of the tree from the side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 正面と同じ形には見えないのですね。横からでも枝全体が見えれば、そちらで描きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 横からの枝全体を描く方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it will not look the same as from the front. If I can see all the branches even from the side, I would like to draw there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you plan to draw all the branches from the side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: あちらからは枝の先まで見えます。画板はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can see right to the branch tips from there. Do you have a drawing board?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持っています。紙を留めるクリップもあります。壁に紙を貼らず、画板を膝に置いて描きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 画板とクリップを示し壁に貼らず膝上で使うと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do. I also have clips to hold the paper. I will draw with the board on my lap, without sticking the paper to the wall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention your drawing board and clips, and say in Japanese that you will use it on your lap without attaching paper to the wall.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ベンチの前は通路です。道具は足元の範囲へまとめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a walkway in front of the bench. Please keep your supplies together within the space around your feet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 絵の具は使いません。鉛筆のケースをかばんに戻せば、通路へ道具を広げずに済みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鉛筆ケースを収納し通路へ道具を広げないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am not using paints. If I put my pencil case back in my bag, I will not need to spread supplies out into the walkway.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will put away your pencil case and keep supplies out of the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その場所から一度、木の見え方を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the view of the tree from that spot first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見てきました。枝の重なり方が面白いので、ここから描き直します。友人にも壁の内側のベンチへ移ったと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新位置の枝の重なりを気に入り描き直し同行者へ移動を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I went and looked. The overlapping branches are interesting, so I will start the drawing again from here. I will also tell my friend I moved to the bench inside the wall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you like the overlapping branches from the new spot, will redraw from there, and will tell your companion you moved.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、木の姿をお楽しみください。お帰りの際は道具をご確認ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy the view of the tree. Check your supplies before leaving. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: バスで回りたい場所を、教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you tell me the places you want to visit by bus?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 温泉と灯台の両方へ行きたいです。先に温泉へ行くつもりですが、そこから灯台へ移れるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 温泉灯台の二目的地で先温泉から移動可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to visit both the hot spring and the lighthouse. I plan to go to the hot spring first, but please tell me whether I can get to the lighthouse from there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can travel from the hot spring first to the lighthouse when visiting both destinations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内の温泉前から灯台前へ行く便があります。地図では、この二つの停留所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a service from the Hot Spring stop to the Lighthouse stop in this guide. These are the two stops on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二つがつながるのですね。温泉を出てから、灯台の方へ行く便を待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 両停留所接続を理解し温泉後灯台便を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the two are connected. After leaving the hot spring, I would like to wait for a bus heading to the lighthouse.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand the two stops connect and will wait for the lighthouse service after the hot spring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 温泉前から灯台前までは、この案内では十五分です。先に灯台へ行く場合も、ご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: According to this guide, it takes fifteen minutes from the Hot Spring stop to the Lighthouse stop. I can also give directions if you go to the lighthouse first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十五分なら、今の順番で考えます。温泉は昼の前に済ませたいので、先に灯台へ変える希望はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 架空十五分経路を理解し午前温泉の順番を保持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: If it takes fifteen minutes, I will keep this order in mind. I want to finish at the hot spring before noon, so I do not wish to change to going to the lighthouse first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the fictional fifteen-minute route in Japanese and keep the order with the hot spring in the morning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お戻りになる場所も、こちらの案内所の近くでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you also be returning to somewhere near this information center?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。灯台前からここへ戻る道も見たいです。行きに使った温泉前へ戻らず、最後は直接こちらへ帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 灯台から案内所へ温泉再経由なしの帰路案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I would also like to see the way back here from the Lighthouse stop. At the end I want to return directly here, without going back to the Hot Spring stop we use on the way out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a route from the lighthouse to the information center without going through the hot spring again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 灯台前から案内所前へ戻る便は、この線です。別の色で印を付けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: This line is the service from the Lighthouse stop back to the Information Center stop. I will mark it in a different color.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。温泉前、灯台前、案内所前の順に丸を付けました。この地図を持って、まず温泉へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三停留所順を図へ印し地図持参で先温泉へ行くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I circled the Hot Spring, Lighthouse, and Information Center stops in that order. I will take this map and head to the hot spring first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you marked the three stops in order on the map and will take it with you to the hot spring first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの案内をお使いください。楽しいお出かけになりますように。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use this guide. I hope you have an enjoyable outing. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日の料理教室へご参加ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you attending today's cooking class?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。エプロンを家に忘れました。今日使う物を一枚借りられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 料理講座用エプロン忘れを伝え一枚貸借を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I left my apron at home. Could I borrow one to use today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you forgot your apron for the cooking class and ask to borrow one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらに貸出し用があります。大人用を一枚でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have aprons for loan here. Would one adult-sized apron be all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大人用をお願いします。首のひもを長くできる物だと助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大人用で首紐長さ調整できる物を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: An adult-sized one, please. It would help if the neck strap could be lengthened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request an adult-sized apron with an adjustable neck strap in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: このひもで長さを調整できます。着けて、届く長さかご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can adjust the length with this strap. Try it on and see whether it reaches the length you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 調整できました。借りた物なので、名前を直接書かずに使えばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 調整成功を伝え借用物へ記名不要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was able to adjust it. Since it is borrowed, should I use it without writing my name directly on it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you adjusted it successfully and ask whether you should leave the borrowed item unnamed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのままお使いください。終わったら、この受付の返却かごへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please use it as it is. When you finish, put it in the return basket at this reception desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分のタオルと一緒に鞄へ入れず、終わった時に返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付かご返却を理解し自己タオルと混ぜ収納しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. I will return it when I finish, without putting it in my bag together with my own towel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will return it to the reception basket and will not pack it with your own towel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの持ち物は、ご用意できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have your other belongings ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: タオルと筆記具はあります。エプロンを借りられたので、教室へ行きます。帰る前に返却かごへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他持物準備済で受講し退出前返却すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have my towel and writing utensils. Now that I have borrowed an apron, I will go to class. I will put it in the return basket before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your other belongings are ready, you will attend class, and you will return it before leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お料理をお楽しみください。お返しはこちらへどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy the cooking class. Return it here, please. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お手元のことで、何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having any trouble with something in your hands?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 待っている間にマスクのひもが切れました。替えを持っていないので、新しい物を一枚用意できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 待合中にマスク紐が切れ替え未持参で新品一枚を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mask strap broke while I was waiting. I do not have a spare, so could you provide one new mask?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your mask strap broke in the waiting area, you have no spare, and you need one new mask.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらに新しいマスクがあります。一枚お渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have new masks here. I will give you one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。切れた方を机に置かず、自分の小さい袋へ入れたいです。袋は鞄にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧物を机へ置かず鞄の自己小袋へ入れたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I would like to put the broken one in my own small bag instead of setting it on the desk. The small bag is in my main bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to put the old mask in your own small bag inside your main bag without placing it on the desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の袋を取り出して、切れた物をしまってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please take out your own bag and put the broken mask away.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: しまえました。新しい方の袋を開けます。耳に掛けるひもは、こちらの両側ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧物収納後新品袋を開き両耳紐位置を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have put it away. I will open the new mask's package. The ear loops are on these two sides, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After putting away the old mask, open the new package and check the positions of both ear loops in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。着け直す時間はございますので、落ち着いてご準備ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. You have time to put it on again, so please get ready calmly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 着けられました。診察の説明を聞く前に替えられて助かりました。新しい袋も自分の袋へまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 着用成功と説明前交換できた礼を述べ外袋もまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have put it on. It helped to change it before listening to the explanation about my examination. I will put the new wrapper in my own bag too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you put it on successfully, thank them for the change before the explanation, and put the wrapper away too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの準備で、確認したい物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is there anything else you want to check as you get ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今はありません。受付の紙は持っています。切れたマスクと外袋は鞄へしまい、この紙を持って案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付紙所持を確認しマスク袋類収納後案内待機する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not at the moment. I have the reception paper. I will put the broken mask and wrappers in my bag and wait for instructions with this paper in hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you have the reception paper and will wait for instructions after putting away the mask and wrappers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お呼びするまでこちらでお待ちください。お大事になさってください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here until we call you. Take care of yourself. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りの前に、何かお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions before you leave?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 相談は終わりましたが、外の雨が強くなりました。傘を持っていないので、こちらで借りられる物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談後降雨が強まり未持傘の貸出有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My consultation has finished, but the rain outside has become heavier. I do not have an umbrella. Do you have one I can borrow here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether umbrellas are available to borrow because rain increased after your consultation and you have none.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 貸出し用の傘があります。こちらの十二番をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have umbrellas for loan. Please use this one, number twelve.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十二番ですね。明日の午前に近くへ来るので、その時に返してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 架空十二番傘を確認し翌午前返却可否を問う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Number twelve, right? I will be nearby tomorrow morning. May I return it then?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the fictional umbrella number twelve and ask in Japanese whether you can return it tomorrow morning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 明日の午前に、この窓口へお返しください。番号の札は付けたままでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please return it to this counter tomorrow morning. Leave the numbered tag attached.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。借りた傘と分かるよう、この札は外しません。自分の持ち物と一緒に覚えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 札を外さず借用番号を保持すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I will not remove this tag, so it is clear the umbrella is borrowed. I will remember it along with my own belongings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will leave the tag attached and keep the borrowed umbrella's number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 開くのは、玄関を出てからにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait until you are outside the entrance to open it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。待合で広げずに、手に持って外へ出ます。紙の控えは鞄へしまって、ぬらさないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 玄関外で開傘し紙控えを鞄へしまうと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will carry it outside without opening it in the waiting room. I will put my paper copy in my bag so it does not get wet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will open the umbrella outside the entrance and put your paper copy in your bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返す時は、傘の番号をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you return it, please tell us the umbrella number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 明日は十二番を返しに来たと伝えます。帰宅したら、午前中の返却予定と番号を手帳にも書いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 翌午前に十二番を返す用件を伝え返却予定と番号を手帳へ記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Tomorrow I will say I have come to return number twelve. When I get home, I will also write the morning return plan and the number in my planner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will explain you are returning number twelve tomorrow morning and note the return plan and number in your planner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お使いください。お足元にお気をつけてお帰りください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use it. Watch your step on your way home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの二箱を、お送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending these two boxes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。両方とも兄の家です。送り状を一枚書いて、コピーをもう一箱へ貼ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同宛先二箱に送り状一枚コピー利用可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Both are going to my older brother's home. Can I fill out one shipping label and attach a copy to the other box?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can use a copy of one shipping label for two boxes going to the same address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの箱に、一枚ずつ送り状をご用意ください。こちらに二枚お渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please prepare one shipping label for each box. I will give you two here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二枚ですね。住所と兄の名前は同じにして、一枚ずつ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱各一枚と理解して住所氏名をそれぞれ記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two, right? I will fill out one for each, with the same address and my brother's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that each box needs its own label and enter the address and name on each.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 箱の中身についても、それぞれの欄へお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also write each box's contents in its respective field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きい箱は衣類、小さい箱は本です。二箱の中身が違うので、内容の欄は別にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 衣類大箱本小箱の内容欄を別記すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The large box contains clothes and the small one contains books. Since the two boxes have different contents, I will fill out the contents fields separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will list the clothes in the large box and books in the small box separately in the contents fields.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 箱へ付ける前に、書いた内容と箱を合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before attaching them, please match the information you wrote with the boxes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 衣類の送り状は大きい箱、本の方は小さい箱です。この順に並べて、お渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送り状と大きさ中身を照合し順に並べ提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The label for clothes goes with the large box, and the one for books with the small box. I will arrange them in this order and hand them over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Match the shipping labels with box sizes and contents, arrange them in order, and hand them over in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お預かりした後は、お荷物ごとの控えをお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After we accept them, we will give you a receipt for each parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、控えも二つ受け取ります。兄へは二箱送ったと知らせ、それぞれの番号を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二控えを受取り兄へ二箱各番号を知らせたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will receive two receipts as well. I want to let my brother know I sent two boxes and give him each one's number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will receive two receipts and want to tell your older brother about the two boxes and their respective numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、二箱を確認してお預かりします。ご準備ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check and accept both boxes now. Thank you for preparing them. Have a safe journey home.
